solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Condition of tank, perhaps, after attack from the air

definitions.text: Condition of tank, perhaps, after attack from the air

parts.words: Condition of tank, perhaps, after attack from the air
parts.note: the air's attack is oxidation, not bombing: a metal water tank left exposed corrodes

explanation.surface: Battle damage to an armoured vehicle after an air raid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tank' suggests the military vehicle and 'attack from the air' an air strike; really the air itself, by oxidation, attacks a metal tank.
explanation.definitionFit: Corrosion from oxygen and moisture leaves iron or steel with a reddish crust, the state the clue describes.

clue.text: A recent reform put through again

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so these letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A recent change in procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: To stage an event a second time is to put it through again, a near synonym.

clue.text: When at sea, curses tea clippers

indicators.note: being at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A sailor swears about the tea aboard the fast sailing ships.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tea clippers' reads as the fast tea-trade sailing ships; the definition is just 'clippers', the garden tool.
explanation.definitionFit: Garden shears for pruning are clippers by another name.

clue.text: Former forward — one who should know better

parts.note: ex is a prefix meaning former
forward in the sense of cheeky means pert

explanation.surface: A one-time forward who ought to have known better.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist is the person who should know more about a subject than anyone else, the wry definition.

clue.text: Name potentially serious mental problem

indicators.note: potentially means in a possible form, so the letters can take another shape

explanation.surface: Naming a mental illness that could become serious.
explanation.definitionFit: An anxiety disorder of the mind is a classic psychological problem.

clue.text: What one said after reflection

parts.note: reflection here is sound bouncing off a surface, which repeats the words one said

explanation.surface: Words spoken after thinking something over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflection' suggests careful thought; here it is sound bouncing back.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation repeats whatever was spoken once the sound is reflected back.

clue.text: Just a second

parts.note: read as only coming second in a race, not as a request to wait a moment

explanation.surface: A request to wait a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: The competitor who finishes merely second is the one placed just behind the winner.

clue.text: Only about five find the solution

indicators.note: about means around, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: sole means only, as in the sole survivor
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Just about five people can work out the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To work out an answer is to resolve the puzzle, the same act.

clue.text: Members of the family, I stress, are out

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A family member insists that some relatives are not at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Female siblings are relatives within one family.

clue.text: Manage to avoid a leakage

definitions.meaning: to evade something, as in getting away from punishment
an outflow of gas or liquid from a container

explanation.definitionFit: Getting clear of something and a seepage of gas are both senses of the same word.

clue.text: Viral disease runs around hospital

indicators.note: around means the first word encloses the second

parts.note: in cricket, singles are runs scored one at a time

explanation.surface: An infection spreads around a hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runs' is not an epidemic spreading but cricket scoring: SINGLES are one-run hits. Cricket is a bat-and-ball game popular in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Herpes zoster, a painful rash caused by the chickenpox virus, is this viral illness.

clue.text: Cite her conversion as a dissenter

indicators.note: a conversion turns something into another form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Quote her religious conversion as proof she is a dissenter.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone holding beliefs against church doctrine is a dissenter from orthodoxy.

clue.text: Rate rise for renovating major roads

indicators.note: renovating means remaking, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A rise in the rates to pay for repairing main roads.
explanation.walkthrough: Rates are a British local property tax that funded councils.
explanation.definitionFit: Main traffic routes are called arterial roads, figuratively blood vessels of the road network.

clue.text: Venerate an American patriot

definitions.meaning: Paul ..., whose midnight ride warned of British troops in 1775

explanation.definitionFit: To honour deeply and the surname of the Boston silversmith hero share one spelling.

clue.text: Streaks out on the ice

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase standing for the people gliding on a rink

indicators.note: out means disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fast movers dashing out onto the rink.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a loose phrase, standing for those who are on the ice.
explanation.definitionFit: People gliding over a frozen rink on blades are those found on the ice.

clue.text: Tight race to retain gold

indicators.note: to retain is to hold inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A close race to keep the gold medal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope pulled tight is stretched taut, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Pack with no score in even game

parts.note: a pack of cards is a deck

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: being quits means being even with someone
O is zero, nil, no score

explanation.surface: A team with no points in a drawn match.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a game played on ships' decks, throwing rings of rope over a peg.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastime on cruise ships, tossing rope rings at a target, is a game.

clue.text: Unoriginal form of flattery

definitions.meaning: copied, fake rather than genuine, as in an attributive noun such as fake leather
from the saying that copying is the sincerest form of flattery

explanation.definitionFit: A copy is unoriginal, and the proverb calls copying the sincerest flattery.

clue.text: Send a letter, but expect nothing to come of it

definitions.text: but expect nothing to come of it
definitions.meaning: to dismiss something as a loss or failure

explanation.definitionFit: Writing away by post and dismissing as worthless are two senses of one phrasal verb.

clue.text: Takes no action about coach reservations

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: someone who takes no action rests
a coach is a railway carriage, part of a train

explanation.surface: A coach company does nothing about seat bookings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coach reservations' suggests bus bookings; 'reservations' alone is the definition, as in doubts or limits.
explanation.definitionFit: Reservations in the sense of qualms or limiting conditions are curbs or checks.

clue.text: Tries to stop son entering repeated exams

indicators.note: entering means going inside the other piece

parts.note: resits are exams taken again after failing

explanation.surface: A parent opposes their son sitting the exams again.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppose or withstand something is to try to stop it.

clue.text: Runner has zero energy

parts.note: nil means zero
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An athlete with no energy left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' suggests an athlete; in crosswords it often means a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A river runs, so crosswords call it a runner; this is the African one.

clue.text: High spot for woman — an opportunity to relax

parts.note: Eve, the first woman in Genesis
a rest is a chance to relax

explanation.surface: A lofty viewpoint where a woman can take a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's tallest mountain is literally the highest spot on Earth.

clue.text: Around church espy lost soul

indicators.note: around means the scrambled letters go round the other piece
lost means astray, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Seeing a lost soul near a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost soul' reads as one phrase in the surface, but 'lost' is the anagram signal on 'espy' and 'soul' stands alone as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek the word means breath or spirit, so the human mind or spirit.

clue.text: Teased about being placid

indicators.note: about here means jumbled around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm despite being teased.
explanation.definitionFit: A calm, unhurried manner is placid, a near synonym.

clue.text: It's caused by an act of duplicity over love

parts.note: a performance by two players, read as duplicity meaning twoness
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Something resulting from double-dealing in a love affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duplicity' usually means deceit, but here it is the state of being two, so an act for two performers. 'over' places O after it in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Attributable to or owing to is the sense of being caused by something.

clue.text: What gun-runners take part in?

parts.note: pictures weapons smugglers as athletes in a competitive race

explanation.surface: Asks what arms smugglers get involved in.
explanation.definitionFit: A competition between nations to build up weapons, punningly a race for those running guns.

clue.text: Policy revealed in a short note

definitions.meaning: as in drop me a few words by post

explanation.definitionFit: A party's official stance and a brief written message share this word.

clue.text: Hasten to expose devious nepotist

indicators.note: devious means winding or crooked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Hurry up and unmask a scheming official who favours relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: This idiom is a command to drive faster, so to hurry.

clue.text: There's copy in the south-east for a writer

indicators.note: in means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for south-east
to crib is to copy someone's work

explanation.surface: A writer's copy is found in the south-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A clerk who copied manuscripts by hand was a professional writer.

clue.text: Artful secret of not having to pay

indicators.note: artful means cunning or crafty, so the letters are craftily rearranged

explanation.surface: The cunning trick of avoiding payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Escaping without penalty or charge is exactly not having to pay.

clue.text: Vegetable and fruit producing edible seed

parts.note: a pea is a vegetable
a nut is botanically a fruit

explanation.surface: A vegetable and a fruit both yield a seed you can eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The groundnut is a legume seed eaten roasted or as butter.
